soldier.name: Soldier
soldier.description: A determined shieldbearer. Mythic rank delivers a devastating, faster sword strike.

archer.name: Archer
archer.description: A hooded ranger whose Mythic bow releases ten arrows a second.

druid.name: Druid
druid.role: Spreads poison before following target priority
druid.description: A forest guardian who first poisons untouched enemies, then follows the selected priority. Expired poison becomes eligible again.
druid.strong: Spreads poison before following target priority

mage.name: Mage
mage.role: Arcane hit with pure splash damage
mage.description: An apprentice with an oversized hat. Impacts send an armor-ignoring shockwave into nearby foes.
mage.strong: Arcane hit with pure splash damage

cleric.name: Cleric
cleric.description: A cheerful keeper of the light. Different blessing ranks combine; duplicates of the same rank do not.

runebreaker.name: Engineer
runebreaker.role: Spreads armor reduction before following target priority
runebreaker.description: A siege engineer whose runic bolts expose armor for allied defenders.
runebreaker.strong: Spreads armor reduction before following target priority
runebreaker.weak: Low solo damage; needs physical allies

frostwarden.name: Frost Warden
frostwarden.description: A winter sentinel. Mythic frost also chills enemies beside the target.

stormcaller.name: Stormcaller
stormcaller.description: A gleeful storm conjurer. Mythic rank delivers three stronger bolts within twelve tiles.

rimewatch.name: Frostbolt Watchmen
rimewatch.description: A winter watch company whose enchanted bolts chill advancing invaders.

frostblade.name: Knight
frostblade.description: A knight whose frostbound weapon scatters a slowing shockwave through enemy ranks.

roseguard.name: Lionheart Champion
roseguard.description: A lion-hearted champion who finds devastating openings in enemy defenses.

highking.name: Kingslayer
highking.description: A black-armored knight whose frostbound blade delivers crushing critical impacts and a runic shockwave.
highking.referenceNote: Jméno Lionheart Champion se přesouvá z této jednotky na Pink Diamond. Při zavádění používat stabilní ID.

crownofages.name: King
crownofages.description: The king bears the crown and a runic blade that breaks armor and enemy formations.
crownofages.referenceNote: Starší extrakt navíc uvádí 50% cleave, +640 damage a −64 armor. Nejde o potvrzení stejné verze jako wiki.

thornwarden.name: Elven Ranger
thornwarden.description: An elven ranger unleashing four arrows in a coordinated volley.

verdantguard.name: Elven Elite Warrior
verdantguard.description: An elite elven warrior directing seven arrows into separate enemies.

tempest.name: Elemental Mage
tempest.description: An elemental mage striking five invaders with simultaneous bolts.

stormcitadel.name: Elemental Archmage
stormcitadel.description: An elemental archmage directing ten simultaneous elemental strikes.

embercrown.name: Fire Baby Dragon
embercrown.description: A young fire dragon radiating a continuous field of burning heat.
embercrown.referenceNote: Oheň je aura, nikoli nový plošný projektil.

worldfire.name: Fire Mother Dragon
worldfire.description: A mother fire dragon guarding the approach with an intense burning aura.

starfall.name: Thunderbird
starfall.description: A thunderbird whose attacks can release lightning across nearby enemies.
starfall.referenceNote: Dosavadní Bastions: 4 vedlejší zásahy. Neoznačovat tento počet za hodnotu doloženou wiki.

thunderheart.name: Dragonrider
thunderheart.description: A dragon rider combining continuous dragon heat with forked lightning.
thunderheart.referenceNote: Rozvětvený blesk zasáhne 5 cílů; není to běžný řetězový blesk. Wiki hodnota je původní, nikoli vyvážená hodnota Bastions.

phoenix.name: Mage Dragon rider
phoenix.role: Fire aura, forked lightning and poisonous attacks
phoenix.description: A mage riding a dragon, commanding lightning, fire and poisonous embers.
phoenix.strong: Fire aura, forked lightning and poisonous attacks
phoenix.referenceNote: Wiki potvrzuje recept, ale efekty jsou prázdné. Extrakt zachycuje jinou verzi a má zvláštní 2s tik hoření.
phoenix.adaptationNote: Abilities filled from the older extracted Gem TD version because the requested wiki leaves them blank.

greenheart.name: Master Druid
greenheart.description: A master druid firing poisonous thorns at advancing invaders.
greenheart.referenceNote: Wiki uvádí nižší DPS než základní Emerald se stejně pojmenovanou schopností. Zachovat údaj této konkrétní věže a označit rozdíl.

eldergrove.name: Archdruid
eldergrove.description: An archdruid whose poisonous thorns and forest guidance extend allied reach.

kingsreach.name: Ballista
kingsreach.description: A heavy ballista whose bolts strip enemy armor for the defending army.

sunward.name: Priest
sunward.description: A priest blessing allied attacks with greater speed and strength.
sunward.referenceNote: +60 attack speed je jednotka Dota; procenta v Bastions jsou adaptace.

winterhold.name: Frost Colossus
winterhold.description: A frost colossus whose ice aura slows surrounding invaders.

dawnspire.name: Angel
dawnspire.role: Winter aura, attack-speed blessing and hidden-enemy detection
dawnspire.description: An angel whose sight, blessing and winter aura protect the defenders.
dawnspire.strong: Winter aura, attack-speed blessing and hidden-enemy detection
dawnspire.referenceNote: Wiki potvrzuje recept. Dosavadní Bastions má vlastní holy útok a kombinaci rychlostní aury se zpomalením.
dawnspire.adaptationNote: Abilities filled from the older extracted Gem TD version because the requested wiki leaves them blank; flat slow becomes a capped percentage.

royalmarshal.name: Dwarf Firebomber
royalmarshal.description: A dwarf bomber whose alchemical fumes weaken surrounding enemy armor.
royalmarshal.referenceNote: Ohnivá bomba může být vizuální motiv; předloha nepřidává burn.

stonewarden.name: Catapult
stonewarden.description: A catapult whose concussive impacts can stun an advancing enemy.

wyvernhunter.name: Ranger
wyvernhunter.description: A ranger whose enchanted arrows weaken and slow flying enemies.
wyvernhunter.referenceNote: Účinek se vztahuje na létající cíle.

royalarsenal.name: Royal Storm Arsenal
royalarsenal.role: Three rapid physical shots ignore evasion
royalarsenal.description: A royal repeating siege engine that fires three precise volleys, ignoring evasion.
royalarsenal.strong: Three rapid physical shots ignore evasion

rangermentor.name: Bearking
rangermentor.description: A druidic bear king whose venom and guidance grant allies range and unfailing aim.

kingdomprotector.name: Paladin
kingdomprotector.description: A paladin bearing a sacred warhammer whose protective ward shields nearby allies from magical control.
kingdomprotector.referenceNote: Starší extrakt uvádí magickou imunitu v auře 600. Dosavadní hra má vlastní adaptaci odolnosti proti ovládání.
kingdomprotector.adaptationNote: Resist is represented by complete protection from disarm and attack suppression; this game has no incoming tower spell damage.

mothernature.name: Nature Spirit
mothernature.referenceAbility: Poison 5; Overlook; Monkey King Bar; Damage
mothernature.referenceNote: Wiki uvádí i alternativní jednorázový recept D1+D2+D3+D4+D5. Tento přehled používá hlavní třísložkový recept.
mothernature.description: A floating nature spirit who guides allied aim and range while poisonous thorns punish the invaders.
mothernature.role: Poison 5; Overlook; Monkey King Bar; Damage
mothernature.strong: Poison 5; Overlook; Monkey King Bar; Damage

royalranger.name: Royal Ranger
royalranger.description: A royal ranger whose venom weakens flying foes and can restore a little keep health.

kingsrangerguard.name: King's Ranger Guard
kingsrangerguard.description: The king's ranger guard strips the armor and magical resistance of flying enemies.

elvenking.name: Elven King
elvenking.referenceNote: Starší extrakt má jiné hodnoty Anti-Fly 2 a 100% magický zásah. Nekombinovat je do údajně přesného efektu wiki.
elvenking.description: The elven king hampers flying enemies and can unleash an explosive magical impact.
elvenking.adaptationNote: Wiki Burned shorthand interpreted as 15% chance of 20x magical splash within four tiles; movement reduction capped at 75%.

fireballista.name: Fire Ballista
fireballista.referenceNote: Název Fire nemění mechaniku: wiki neuvádí hoření, ohnivou auru ani změnu typu poškození.
fireballista.description: An ornate ballista whose enchanted bolts expose armor for nearby defenders.

emeraldgolem.name: Golem
emeraldgolem.referenceNote: Podmínka pohledu na golema je součástí předlohy. Corrupt zde uvádí −20, ne −30 jako Gold.
emeraldgolem.description: A stone golem whose stunning blows and petrifying gaze break enemy formations.
emeraldgolem.adaptationNote: The wiki leaves gaze duration and slow strength unspecified; this campaign uses six seconds and 80% slow.

griffinbomber.name: Dwarf Griffin bomber
griffinbomber.description: A dwarf griffin bomber whose concussive charges weaken armor and magical resistance.

mechanicalgolem.name: Mechanical Golem
mechanicalgolem.referenceNote: Recept je na wiki; schopnosti doložené jen jinou verzí. Extrakt uvádí poloměr slow 300 a aury 1 200.
mechanicalgolem.description: A mechanical golem combining toxic darts, armor-breaking strikes and freezing alchemical fumes.
mechanicalgolem.adaptationNote: Abilities filled from the older extracted Gem TD version because the requested wiki leaves them blank.
mechanicalgolem.role: Toxic attacks, armor reduction and healing suppression
mechanicalgolem.strong: Toxic attacks, armor reduction and healing suppression

monk.name: Monk
monk.referenceNote: Zachovat dvě samostatné skupiny rychlostních aur při převodu do Bastions.
monk.description: A monk maintains two battle chants, inspiring allies and shielding them from magical control.

archbishop.name: Archbishop
archbishop.referenceNote: Starší extrakt uvádí i zděděnou podporu a jiné Otomad +200. Prioritu má hodnota +500 z požadované wiki.
archbishop.description: An archbishop whose commanding chant greatly accelerates allied attacks.

archangel.name: Archangel
archangel.referenceNote: Wiki potvrzuje recept, nikoli efekty. Spouštěč je runová deska (pedal/slate), nikoli běžný útok. Poškození koule není v extraktu vyčísleno.
archangel.description: An archangel spreads winter over the path and releases a bouncing frost sphere.
archangel.adaptationNote: User-approved adaptation: 25% chance when an ally within six tiles lands a magical attack; ten frost bounces at the Archangel's attack damage. Own attacks, blocked hits and secondary bounces do not trigger it.
archangel.role: Winter aura and allied-magic-triggered frost bounces
archangel.strong: Winter aura and allied-magic-triggered frost bounces

ladyclaire.name: Lady Claire
ladyclaire.description: A crowned, green-eyed blonde lady in an ivory and gold gown. Her radiant staff commands chain and forked lightning, though Melancholy can briefly still her magic.
ladyclaire.role: Chain lightning, forked lightning and Melancholy
ladyclaire.strong: Lightning strikes spread through enemy groups
ladyclaire.weak: Melancholy can stop her attacks for five seconds
ladyclaire.referenceVerification: Wiki and older author extract for missing parameters
ladyclaire.referenceNote: Requested wiki supplies damage 1225, range 1000, chain chance 20% and fork chance 50%. Its attack interval and detailed proc values are blank.
ladyclaire.adaptationNote: Missing parameters use the specific Fantastic Miss Shrimp author extract: interval 0.5s, chain damage 150 to five other enemies within 1000 per jump, fork damage 2500 to five enemies within 5000, and 3% attack-start Melancholy for 5s. Current wiki chances override the extract's older chances. Range uses 100 source units per tile; requested damage values remain unscaled.

lordbernhard.name: Lord Bernhard
lordbernhard.description: A knight in radiant silver and gold armour and an ornate closed helmet, seated on a white horse with his sword raised. His presence extends allied reach and guides unfailing strikes.
lordbernhard.role: Poison attacks, allied range and true strike
lordbernhard.strong: Poison pressure and nearby allies that ignore evasion
lordbernhard.weak: Requires three differently ranked Soldiers in one round
lordbernhard.referenceNote: Requested wiki damage 3164, attack interval 0.5s, range 1300, poison at 16/s for 5s, +300 range and nearby true strike. Poison 5 is the ability grade, not five targets: this is a single-target attack. Aura reach uses the existing 300-unit/three-tile support radius. No critical strike is added from older versions. Requested damage values remain unscaled; range uses 100 source units per tile.
